issue.title: add support for raw str params

repository.name: aiohttp
repository.description: Asynchronous HTTP client/server framework for asyncio and Python

issue.body:
So, this is a port of missing `requests` feature.

Please drop if it doesn't fit the API vision.

My use case:

```
yield from session.get(url, params=urllib.parse.urlencode(payload, safe='+'))
```

Thanks for a great library.

body: I think what we need to do here is to change `encode_params` to make sure that it calls `to_native_string` on its argument before returning it. This seems like a bug we can fix pretty swiftly, and is well suited to a new contributor, so I'll mark this as `Contributor Friendly`.

repository.name: requests
repository.description: A simple, yet elegant, HTTP library.

body: This fix seems completely broken. It prevents me from uploading binary data through PUT.

issue.title: Request with binary payload fails due to calling to_native_string

repository.name: requests
repository.description: A simple, yet elegant, HTTP library.

issue.body:
Introduced with https://github.com/kennethreitz/requests/issues/2844

```
import requests
requests.put("http://httpbin.org/put", data=u"ööö".encode("utf-8"))
```

This works with 2.8.1, but not with 2.9.

body:
Could you release a quick 2.9.1 with this fix plz ?

I was waiting the 2.9.0 for the REQUEST_CA_BUNDLE env var but cannot use it for the moment due to this bug ;-(
@touilleMan We're planning to release 2.9.1 on Monday.
Looking forward to the new release. This bug breaks everything, since we use Chinese...
